titulo: Histologic heterogeneity in synchronous bilateral breast cancer: a case report and literature review

fig.label: Figure 2
fig.caption: Mammographic findings of bilateral breast lesions. (A, B) Craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) views of the left breast demonstrating an irregular spiculated mass with punctate calcifications. (C, D) Craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) views of the right breast showing focal asymmetric density.
